'''Tomohiro Waki''' (Japanese: '''脇知弘''' ''Waki Tomohiro'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Waki was born on October 11, 1980, in {{wp|Hiratsuka, Kanagawa}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He provided the voice of [[Stephan]], one of {{Ash}}'s [[rival]]s in the [[Unova]] [[region]], during {{aniseries|BW}}. Waki is currently affiliated with the talent agency AT Production. In addition, he is a professional wrestler.
